nodes.summary: The eigenvalues of the block-counting generator, `-(k.choose 2)`.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of Kingman's block-counting generator

nodes.summary: The columns of `blockCountingRightEigen n` are right eigenvectors: `G V = V D`.
nodes.title: Right eigenvector equation for the block-counting generator

nodes.summary: The rate matrix of Kingman's block-counting (pure-death) process on `{0, …, n}`: `k` lineages become `k - 1` at rate `k.choose 2`, time in units of `M = 2N` generations.
nodes.title: Generator of Kingman's block-counting process

nodes.summary: The rows of `blockCountingLeftEigen n` are left eigenvectors: `W G = D W`.
nodes.title: Left eigenvector equation for the block-counting generator

nodes.summary: The left and right eigenvector matrices are mutually inverse: `W V = 1`.
nodes.title: Left and right eigenvector matrices are mutually inverse

nodes.summary: Left eigenvectors of the block-counting generator, as rows: row `0` is the indicator of state `0`, and for `1 ≤ k` row `k` has entries `(2k-1) (-1)^{k-j} j^{(k-1)} / (j! (k-j)!)` for `j ≤ k` and `0` for `j > k`; the eigenvalue is `-(k.choose 2)`.
nodes.title: Left eigenvectors of Kingman's block-counting generator

nodes.summary: Right eigenvectors of the block-counting generator, as columns: column `k` has entries `i_{(k)} / i^{(k)}` (falling over rising factorial) and eigenvalue `-(k.choose 2)`.
nodes.title: Right eigenvectors of Kingman's block-counting generator

nodes.summary: The transition probabilities of Kingman's block-counting process from `i` to `j` lineages in time `t`, for `1 ≤ j ≤ i ≤ n`, are given by `tavareProb`.
nodes.title: Tavaré's formula

nodes.summary: For `n ≤ N`, the top-left `(n + 1) × (n + 1)` block of the transition matrix `exp (t • G)` of the block-counting process on `{0, …, N}` is the transition matrix of the process on `{0, …, n}` (the process only moves down). Holds for every real `t`.
nodes.title: Truncation consistency

nodes.summary: The block-counting process never gains lineages: `exp (t • G) i j = 0` for `i < j`. Holds for every real `t`.
nodes.title: The block-counting process never gains lineages

nodes.summary: The spectral decomposition of the transition matrix of the block-counting process: `exp (t • G) = V diag(exp (-(k.choose 2) t)) W`.
nodes.title: Spectral decomposition of the block-counting transition matrix

nodes.summary: Tavaré's closed form for the probability that `i` lineages of Kingman's coalescent have `j` ancestors `t` time units (`2N` generations each) earlier, for `1 ≤ j ≤ i`.
nodes.title: Tavaré's formula for the number of ancestral lineages

nodes.summary: The scaled one-generation increment `M • (wfLineageMatrix n M - 1)` converges entrywise to the block-counting generator: `k` lineages coalesce to `k - 1` with probability `(k.choose 2) / M + o(1/M)`, and to fewer with probability `O(1/M²)`.
nodes.title: Scaled Wright–Fisher lineage matrix converges to Kingman's generator

nodes.summary: For `t ≥ 0`, the `⌊t M⌋`-generation transition matrix of the Wright–Fisher ancestral lineage count converges, as the population size `M` tends to infinity, to the transition matrix `exp (t • G)` of the pure-death process with rates `k.choose 2`.
nodes.title: Kingman's theorem for the lineage count

nodes.summary: The one-generation transition matrix of the ancestral lineage count of a sample of at most `n` gene copies in a Wright–Fisher population of `M` copies; row `k`, column `j` is `wfLineageProb M k j`.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transition matrix of the lineage count

nodes.summary: One-generation transition probability of the ancestral lineage count in a neutral Wright–Fisher population of `M` gene copies: `k` lineages pick their parents uniformly and independently among `M` copies, and `j` distinct parents occur with probability `stirlingSecond k j * M.descFactorial j / M ^ k`.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher transition probability of the lineage count
